skills.description: Create a risk-prioritized, technique-driven test plan with complete requirement and risk traceability.
Review and improve a plan with exact findings, modifications, checksums, and before/after coverage metrics.
Choose the lowest effective automation level and produce approval-gated Playwright API and browser candidates.
Implement only approved Playwright API and browser candidates as verified TypeScript tests without accepted flakiness.
Run authorized session-based exploratory testing with indexed evidence and reproducible local defect folders.
Audit WCAG 2.2 AA scope with automated axe results, manual evidence, unresolved criteria, and linked defects.
Evaluate declared performance budgets or establish a repeatable Lighthouse and API timing baseline without inventing an SLA.
